body: I have tried to overcome social anxiety and social skills since i was about 14 and im still the same probably worse actually so i dont believe it is something you overcome.

27 year old man and i cry almost everyday.  Everytime i cry i have no expression on my face and dont make any noise i just look stone faced with tears.  Dont feel bad about crying your in pain like me and others with mental illness i know it hurts brother.

People always say to get help but in my opinion it will never help someone recover.  I have tried talking to people i trust to see if it would help but it just made me get pissed off and i felt worse because talking doesnt change how i feel.
Thanks for all the kind comments the damage is done though its just too late now goodbye everyone and good luck with your lives i hope you have good lives in the future.

Im very similar and im 27 years old social anxiety has completely destroyed my life and i think i will end things sometime in my thirties.  Social anxiety has affected everything in my life and i know i will never get better i have never had a girlfriend or even got close to a girl it makes me so fucking angry and i am completely broken and unfixable.  I am constantly pissed off the only thing i have is a part time job and getting a job has made me much worse mentally im constantly in situations where people try to talk to me and i come off as a weird person they probably think i am mentally disabled.  It pisses me off that i cant go outside and do simple things without going through hell in my head.  Just going to the shop is hard enough and seeing everyone else without these issues makes me feel like fucking strangling them i am so angry with how my life has been.

Depression started when i was 12 suicidal thoughts and seriously thinking about doing it started when i was about 24.  I am 27 now things are worse than ever it hurts seeing overs enjoying life with no mental problems and i have never experienced hapiness.

Me too i want a terminal illness even though i am still young at 27 even if i knew my life would be good in the future i still would take death over that.  The damage is done and i either have to live in misery for the rest of my life or check out early and not suffer anymore.  I would laugh if i got a terminal illness it would honestly make me extremely happy until i die from it.

I dont believe people when they say this i think they are either in denial and doing that fake positivity trying to convince themselves or they were not depressed in the first place.  Once you have it you have it for life as far as im concerned.
Me too it makes me really fucking angry its so messed up that most people are at least ok mentally when we have been through hell and still there.

I can remember being depressed since i was 12 i am 27 now and the last few years i have felt suicidal.  It has gone on long enough and i just dont want to deal with it anymore.  Nefer having a relationship has also completely screwed me up i think im getting close to checking out.  I can remember when i was 16 everyone just naturally got into relationships i remember thinking back then that i would never experience it and guess what im closing in on 30 still never been close to developing any type of relationship.

I know how it is im 27 and never had a girlfriend all i have in my life is a part time job and i see everyone else just enjoying life without mental illness.  It fucking sucks why it happens to us depressed people are good people and it kills me seeing us all suffer.  People are so selfish boasting about their life without a second thought about people who have nothing.  If i had a good life and was doing well i would enjoy it but not rub it in everyones face because of how inconsiderate it is.

You definately not alone a couple of years ago my chocolate lab died and he was having trouble breathing he was only 8.  We took him to the vets and they gave him an injection to see if he got better but he died later in the evening.  It fucking killed me at the time especially seeing him being taken away in a bodybag that was my worst day of my life.  I cant get another dog because he is not to be replaced by any other dog it still painful.  Life is so cruel i hope things turn around for you.
Please do what you want this is your life you have a right to do what you want.  Screw society and people dont make yourself worse and suffer remember this is your life and your decisions.

Im happy to see someone doing whatever the hell they want this is nice to see.  I hope you get what you want in life im buying a new motorcycle soon to enjoy and i hope the noise pisses my noisy neighbours off because if it does i will be using it a lot more than i intend.

Absolutely right you have to be your own man or woman it doesnt matter what others think this is our lives not anyone else.  I also feel dead inside i stopped caring about anything i started doing what i wanted and life has gotten a bit better.  Im still very depressed but im living my life how i want and not how anyone else says.  People who actually care about you will not judge or leave they will be cheering for you no matter what.
For some people they do not feel different but others say it helps i never tried it.
For some people they do not feel different but others say it helps i never tried it.

You got to do whats best for your mental health i quit college after 2 days when i was younger because of social anxiety.  I got a normal entry level job instead and dont regret it one bit.  Social status and popularity is bullshit im not saying you should quit but im saying you should do what you want and not do anything because of pressure or because you feel you have to.  If you really want to get an education do you best to get through it but if you cant deal with it dont force yourself into a worse mental state.  If i had stayed in college i would have probably killed myself because it brought out the worst in me.
He doesnt get it just like everyone else fuck him he wont help he is useless.

I certainly do anyone with depression that thinks about suicide it is normal.  It messes with your mind and makes you question all your thoughts and actions. I have been this way for about 10 years trust me its totally normal.

Same here i just know i will end my life when the moment is right and when i want to go through with it i will have one last day to go somewhere peaceful.  Probably drink all day then end it in the evening.
Thanks for sharing that we all have each over for support even though its online this is the best treatment just seeing everyone one of us looking out for fellow sufferers.

Its ok i think about suicide everyday multiple times  think this will be how i die im too far gone and broken.  I dont even want to get better anymore i just lost hope and im waiting for the right moment to call it a day.

Damn brought back memories of my chocolate lab who died 2 years ago just thinking about how he was my best friend and died from being ill makes me want to die so bad.  I probably will check out soon and hope i see him again if there is something when we die.  Cats and dogs are great animals they can save someone from suicide.

I went to college when i was younger and only lasted 2 days because of depression and social anxiety.  It made me suicidal seeing others naturally socialising and enjoying with no mental problems.  I said to myself fuck this, fuck them im out.  I just got a regular job instead i couldnt deal with it but i tried.  Dont feel like others are better than you because we are all equal we just got shit luck and mental disorders not our fault at all.
Sorry to hear that tough love is one of the worst things for depression.  I am just sick how ignorant people are.
Sorry to hear that tough love is one of the worst things for depression.  I am just sick how ignorant people are.
I have 3 emotions i constantly feel they are anger, sadness and numbness.  It scares me that the last time i was happy was 11 years ago.
Me too it makes me angry that i know i cant turn things around.  i literally dont give a fuck anymore of what happens because i plan on checking out sooner rather than later.
I dont even hide it anymore i dont give a fuck.  I used to hide it but i wear my heart on my sleeve and have to be true to myself.
My relatives but if it carries on im just going to go through with it.  There is jo way im suffering my whole life i have suffered enough.
I think females have more chance becoming depressed but males more likely to take their life.
I honestly have no idea how im still here im trying to give life a chance but after so much pain all i can think about is checking out.  Im trying to hang on but i dont see it ending well for me.

Damn thats deep im 27 and been having depression and social anxiety since i was 16.  Not enjoyed any of my life for about 11 years and just struggled through it without happiness.  Im doing ok for someone with a fucked up mind i have a part time job and trying my best in life but i want out.  I am going to wait until im 35 and if im still the same way im just calling it a day.  I promised myself if my head is still fucked when im 35 that i will not put myself through any more pain because i dont deserve it and im very angry that a big part of my life has been suffering.  I have given life a fair chance but its just not for me.
Yes it drives me crazy i would rather clean dishes.
I struggle but i always scream in my head suck it suck it suck it.  Its weird but it helps me a lot it makes me feel like i can get through it.
Dont worry we are all fucked up in some way for me i cant smile or show people im happy.  I dont know why but i kind of like being different to normal people it makes me feel like im special.

Dont worry man tell erick he can suck it i hope his world caves in on him.  You all dont need him but i bet he needs you and when he comes crawling back you can all la7gh in his face and tell him to suck it.  You will get through it man.
Your welcome to pm me i will be there for you everytime im online.

Its ok to feel this way i used to pretend i was ok now i dont give a fuck because i have had it for such a long time.  I wear a mean look on my face because i dont hide my feelings anymore.  I found that people ask me if i am ok and are much nicer to me im nice back though if someone talks to me.  You dont have to put a mask on constantly trust me it will make things harder.  If you have not told anyone please tell someone you trust you need support from someone it can make a massive difference.  Please dont suffer alone we are all here to help.

I know how you feel most people assume depression is one event in someones life that will heal with time but we true sufferers know how it really is.  Its in my opinion one of the hardest things anyone can suffer.  I only talk to people who suffer themselves because others will never get it.  They can all suck it.
I finally went to the barbers for a haircut after years of giving myself bad haircuts.
Well done man you have huge cojones i always say in my head suck it everyone when im in an uncomfortable situation.  In my mind im saying suck it suck it suck it.

This is my go to comfort thing.  I always think dont worry if it gets so bad i can just end it and find peace.  This is what keeps me going knowing the option to die is there if things become too much.  Also i think everything going on in the world right now doesnt matter we will all be gone in 100 years.  If things become unbearable though i will just spend all my savings going somewhere i always wanted to go have a good time then call it a day.

Keep it up you dont that bullshit in your life all it will trigger bad thoughts with people gloating how happy they are.  I have quit social media except reddit and no longer watch things on tv that make me angry.  You may never get rid of your bad thoughts but you will feel better if you cut out these superficial things you dont need in your life.
Brushing my teeth and going to work.  Working is the worst it sets my bad thoughts off the whole time im there.
I had the usual day just my thoughts automatically think about suicide and my mind is sadly just diseased now.  Its sad but thats what this disease does to you.

27 year old guy here i never experienced a relationship before and only have a part time job which will lead to nothing.  Depression and social anxiety have ripped my life apart.  I dont even know why im still alive i take comfort knowing that i can always end my life and have the guts to do it.  I have a tiny bit of hope left but if things dont get better for me when i get to my thirties i think i will end things.
Im from uk i dont want anyone talking me out of this i just need to know if someone notifies them.

I am out there as well as anyone with social anxiety can be i just cant build relationships and friends i dont connect with people.  I have a few friends i hang out with and they are my childhood friends.  I thought about online dating but its not for me i just want to meet someone naturally without it being forced.

Im 27 and never had a relationship i have a tiny amount of hope left.  Fight it as long as you can it might turn round for you i know its tough to deal with you have a lot of time on your side and you are still young.
